messages:
Maya (FinOps): MeterCo sent renewal + invoice INV-2026-0602. Their usage line doesn't match our export by ~9%. Can someone take a quick look? Link: drive.redwood/vendor/meterco/renewal (redacted)

Jared (Procurement): 9% is material. Did they change metering rules or SDK?

Iris (Platform): We rolled the SDK v1.4 on 2026-02-21 which collapses n requests into a single batch. If MeterCo counts per-item instead of per-call that explains it.

Maya (FinOps): Evan (MeterCo) can you confirm how MeterCo counts batched requests? We need a line-by-line reconciliation for Jan-Mar.

Evan (MeterCo): Hi all — we count by event unless request_id is present. If SDK sends a single request_id for a batch we count once. Share an example request_id and we'll pull logs.

BillingBot: Billing export: /billing/exports/meterco-2026-q1.csv

Iris (Platform): Example request_id: req_7d4f9c. SDK payload example: {"request_id":"req_7d4f9c","items":[{},{}]}

Evan (MeterCo): Got it. We'll run a reconcile: CSV mapping request_id -> our_units -> your_units. If we overcounted we'll issue a credit on INV-2026-0602 or apply to next invoice.

Maya (FinOps): Please include two renewal options in the pro-forma: (A) per-call pricing (preferred), (B) current per-item rate with credit guardrails. Also add audit clause to allow quarterly log review for discrepancies >1%.

Evan (MeterCo): Will include both options + SOW language. ETA: 24 hours.

Jared (Procurement): Also request a short pilot price for 3 months so we can test per-call semantics before committing.

Evan (MeterCo): Noted. I'll upload pro-forma + recon CSV later today.

Maya (FinOps): Thanks. If reconcile shows >1% overbilling we want the credit and the pilot option included in the renewal doc.
